column1: # Forge 1.20.1 methods NeoForge 1.21.1 lacks -> static helper in legacyconnector/v1_20_1/ForgeApi1201 (receiver first for instance calls)
# key: owner.name+descriptor as it is after the class renames (facade classes are legacyconnector/v1_20_1/net/minecraftforge/...); value: helper name
# capabilities: any receiver (block entity, entity, stack, level, a mod's own provider); super.getCapability of a Minecraft parent becomes superGetCapability
# items: Item.initCapabilities(stack, nbt) (a super call has nothing to call: the helper answers "no capabilities")
# generic event listeners (AttachCapabilitiesEvent<T>): filtered by the object type
# cancellation: Forge's Event had setCanceled/isCanceled/isCancelable itself (key "@event.": any NeoForge event class as the owner)
# milestone 2: NBT/packet/capability signatures that moved to registry-aware or component-based forms
